title: Introduce intake sentinel and brief compiler for compact changelogs
author: Alyssa Chen
description: Context: onboarding churn and long autogenerated release notes make it hard for engineers to quickly assess risk and performance impact of new model variants. This PR adds two cooperating subsystems: an intake-sentinel that runs lightweight sanity and cost/perf heuristics during model intake, and a brief-compiler that synthesizes compact, human-friendly changelog fragments and performance highlight cards. Motivation: reduce noise in release notes, accelerate review turnaround, and catch obvious regressions earlier in the pipeline. Scope: sentinel rules (schema checks, common-freeze tokens, latency/cost delta thresholds), telemetry-sampler hook (emits sampled perf traces for new variants), brief compiler (compact prose + delta table + example prompts), automation pipeline changes to attach compiled briefs to model uploads, and tests + migration. Checklist: - implement sentinel engine and rule registry; - add telemetry-sampler integration and sampling policy; - implement brief compiler with templating and delta heuristics; - attach compiled brief to model registry artifacts and release draft; - add unit + e2e tests and CI job; - docs stub for reviewer workflow. Impact: aims to be backward-compatible with existing onboard flows; sentinel blocks uploads only when high-confidence critical violations are detected (configurable); compiled briefs are optional by feature flag. Related: ENG-2173 (onboard quality gates), ENG-2201 (changelog noise reduction).

review_thread: Diego Morales: Please clarify the threshold logic for latency regressions; is it absolute or relative?
Alyssa Chen: It's relative by default (pct delta over baseline) with an override for absolute ms in config; added comment and unit test to cover both paths.
Priya Natarajan: The sampled telemetry may add cost—can we cap sample rate per-org?
Alyssa Chen: Yes, sample rate is org-scoped and defaults to 0.5% for new variants; rate is configurable via infra flags; noted in docs.
Tomás Silva: Brief templating looks good but include a terse machine-readable summary for automated rollouts.
Alyssa Chen: Added a JSON summary blob alongside the human brief (brief.summary.json) for rollouts and A/B tooling.
Priya Natarajan: Approving pending a green E2E run.
CI: onboard-e2e passed on rerun; lint and unit tests green.
merge_outcome: merged (squash) into main after CI green; release draft artifact includes compiled brief and sampled telemetry links.
release_notes: Adds an intake sentinel that enforces lightweight sanity and perf heuristics during model onboarding and a brief compiler that synthesizes compact changelog fragments and perf highlight cards. Config: sentinel rules and telemetry sampling are configurable per-org. Migration: no forced data migration; new briefs appear when feature flag enabled.
notes_for_ops: Feature disabled by default; rollout plan: enable for internal onboarding namespace for 2 weeks, monitor noise and blocked uploads, then enable opt-in for customers. Ops should watch telemetry.sampled_rate and sentinel.block_rate metrics.
security_considerations: Sentinel performs schema and token checks only; no model weights or PII are stored by new components. Telemetry sampler respects PII redaction and follows existing telemetry retention policies.
testing_summary: Unit tests cover rule evaluator edge cases and template rendering; e2e smoke simulates a model intake with synthetic perf traces and verifies compiled brief attachment. CI adds an on-demand onboard-e2e job that runs in the PR pipeline.
long_term_roadmap: Follow-ups: add automated severity scoring for changelog snippets, integrate with release-brief web UI, and expose brief diffing in model history timeline.
